_comment: VibeVoice 2-speaker dialogue workflow for the podcast app's single-pass multi-speaker mode. Takes a speaker-labelled transcript ({script}, lines formatted '[1] text' / '[2] text') + two reference-voice wavs ({speaker1}, {speaker2}, already uploaded into ComfyUI input/) and outputs ONE mp3 of the whole conversation. Replaces the per-turn TTS + pydub-stitch path.
_requires: ComfyUI-VibeVoice custom node (github.com/wildminder/ComfyUI-VibeVoice). Model: VibeVoice-1.5B (~7GB VRAM). VERIFIED against object_info on this install 2026-06-06 — VibeVoiceTTS required inputs: model_name(enum VibeVoice-1.5B|VibeVoice-Large), text, quantize_llm_4bit(bool), attention_mode(enum eager|sdpa|flash_attention_2), cfg_scale, inference_steps, seed, do_sample(bool), temperature, top_p, top_k, force_offload(bool); optional speaker_1_voice..speaker_4_voice (AUDIO). attention_mode=sdpa avoids a flash-attention install. Set quantize_llm_4bit=true to cut VRAM further.
